title: America Has 165 Volcanoes—More Than Indonesia
hook: Indonesia gets the fame, but America counts 165 volcanoes.
closing: Volcano fame follows eruptions; the actual count tells another story.
question: Which volcano country surprised you?

segments.say: The United States leads with 165 volcanoes; Indonesia ranks only fourth behind Japan and Russia.
Alaska alone has 130 volcanoes, more than Indonesia's entire total.
Three in four volcanoes sit on the Ring of Fire, linking Alaska, Japan, and Indonesia.
